courses.title: Introductory Chem.
courses.prerequisiteText: Pre-Calculus 12 (or equivalent), MATH 100 (may be taken concurrently), or permission of the department. No previous training in chemistry is required for this course.
courses.description: Introduces the general principles of chemistry. It is designed for students with little or no prior background in chemistry. The course covers key concepts such as terminology, stoichiometry, chemical calculations, nuclear and atomic structures, chemical bonding, reaction rates, equilibrium, and the properties of gases, liquids, and solids. Students who intend to take further laboratory courses in chemistry should also take CHEM 115.
